subject: ggvis in multiple tabs (Move Explorer example)

messages.author: 87dda432a70bcd01
messages.subject: ggvis in multiple tabs (Move Explorer example)
parts:
Hi,

I am new to creating visualizations with shiny. Specifically interested learning to make interactive visuals.

I tried to replicate the "Movie Explorer" example, but with an additional tab and a visual. But it does not work as I want it to. I get no visuals in both the tabs. Can you please take a look at the code below and check what is wrong!?

The only change in the 'server.R' file is the addition of "vis %>% bind_shiny("plot2")" at the end to reference to the visual in the second tab. 

And below is the 'ui.R' file for two tabs and the interactive movie visual in each. The changes are at the end where i create a new tab and have a reference for the visual.

Any help will be greatly appreciated!!

library(ggvis)

# For dropdown menu

actionLink <- function(inputId, ...) {

  tags$a(href='javascript:void',

         id=inputId,

         class='action-button',

         ...)

}


shinyUI(fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Movie explorer"),

  fluidRow(

    column(2,

      wellPanel(

        h4("Filter"),

        sliderInput("reviews", "Minimum number of reviews on Rotten Tomatoes",

          10, 300, 80, step = 10),

        sliderInput("year", "Year released", 1940, 2014, value = c(1970, 2014)),

        sliderInput("oscars", "Minimum number of Oscar wins (all categories)",

          0, 4, 0, step = 1),

        sliderInput("boxoffice", "Dollars at Box Office (millions)",

          0, 800, c(0, 800), step = 1),

        selectInput("genre", "Genre (a movie can have multiple genres)",

          c("All", "Action", "Adventure", "Animation", "Biography", "Comedy",

            "Crime", "Documentary", "Drama", "Family", "Fantasy", "History",

            "Horror", "Music", "Musical", "Mystery", "Romance", "Sci-Fi",

            "Short", "Sport", "Thriller", "War", "Western")

        ),

        textInput("director", "Director name contains (e.g., Miyazaki)"),

        textInput("cast", "Cast names contains (e.g. Tom Hanks)")

      ),

      wellPanel(

        selectInput("xvar", "X-axis variable", axis_vars, selected = "Meter"),

        selectInput("yvar", "Y-axis variable", axis_vars, selected = "Reviews"),

        tags$small(paste0(

          "Note: The Tomato Meter is the proportion of positive reviews",

          " (as judged by the Rotten Tomatoes staff), and the Numeric rating is",

          " a normalized 1-10 score of those reviews which have star ratings",

          " (for example, 3 out of 4 stars)."

        ))

      )

    ),

    column(5,

      ggvisOutput("plot1"),

      wellPanel(

        span("Number of movies selected:",

          textOutput("n_movies")

        )

      )

    ),

    column(5,

      ggvisOutput("plot2"),

      wellPanel(

        span("Number of movies selected:",

          textOutput("n_movies")

        )

      )

    )

  )

))
